verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a managed live-streaming and real-time video infrastructure service. It is not an agent or AI assistant that would act as an MCP client and call external tools, so this story is a category error for the product type. Nothing in the evidence shows IVS shipping any MCP-client or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
